title: 刚搬来美国，怎么给孩子报名上学？
summary: 在美国孩子上学按学区划分，报名要带住址证明和疫苗记录。这篇教你报名流程，以及到校后必问的几句话。

featuredPhrase.en: How do I enroll my child in school?

phrases.en: How do I enroll my child in school?
What documents do I need for enrollment?
What time does school start and end?
phrases.zh: 学校几点上课、几点放学？

phrases.en: Where do I pick up my child?
What supplies does my child need?
phrases.zh: 我孩子需要准备什么文具？

dialogue.speaker: Parent
dialogue.en: Hi, we just moved here. How do I enroll my child in school?
dialogue.zh: 你好，我们刚搬来。怎么给孩子报名上学？

dialogue.speaker: Office Staff
dialogue.en: Welcome! First, I need proof of address, like your lease, and your child's vaccine records.
dialogue.zh: 欢迎！首先我需要住址证明，比如租房合同，还有孩子的疫苗记录。

dialogue.speaker: Parent
dialogue.en: I have the lease with me. What grade will he be in?
dialogue.zh: 租房合同我带了。他会上几年级？

dialogue.speaker: Office Staff
dialogue.en: Based on his age, he'll be in 2nd grade. School starts at 8:00 and dismisses at 2:45.
dialogue.zh: 按年龄他上二年级。学校 8 点上课，下午 2 点 45 放学。

dialogue.speaker: Parent
dialogue.en: Where do I pick him up? And can he ride the school bus?
dialogue.zh: 我去哪里接他？他能坐校车吗？

dialogue.speaker: Office Staff
dialogue.en: Pickup is at the front circle. Yes, there's a bus stop two blocks from your address.
dialogue.zh: 在学校前面的环岛接。可以坐校车，离你家两个街区就有一个站点。

seoTitle: 在美国给孩子报名上学要带什么？
seoDescription: 刚搬来美国，怎么给孩子报名上学？本文讲报名要带的材料、学区划分，以及到校必问的英语表达，附完整对话。
